title: wg: draft-mahy-mimi-av-metadata-02 gaps (key text vs integer, CDDL reference, rotation)
description:
From assay mimid-1wgh.44.18 of /home/mark/PROJECT/IETF/specs/draft-mahy-mimi-av-metadata-02.txt. Posting needs Mark's OK.
1. Key: the CDDL uses the text key "av_metadata" (§3) while §6.1 registers integer key 6 named 'av-metadata'. content-10 §8.2.1 reserves text-string keys for private use, so the CDDL must use 6 (and one spelling of the name).
2. CDDL citation is [RFC8160], 'IUTF8 Terminal Mode in Secure Shell' (§3, §7); CDDL is RFC 8610.
3. Rotation vs orientation: width/height and 'width larger than height is landscape' (§3) are before or after applying rotation? Say which.
4. part_index: point at content-10's definition of the part index (content-10 txt L751-754) and say what a receiver does with an index naming a MultiPart or a part that does not exist; preview_index's rules (§3) say 'must be an image with a disposition value of preview' but not what to do otherwise.
5. Security TODO: accessibility_text can differ from the media (misleading alt text, e.g. hiding abusive images from screen-reader users or moderators); width/height/duration are sender claims a client must not trust for allocation.
6. Example uses '/partIndex /' labels for part_index; content-09 reference (now -10).
